versions.changelog: 支持话题活动发布(theme_id)，更新SKILL文档

Initial release of juejin skill:  
- Automates operations on the Juejin platform.
- Supports posting Pins (沸点) to specified topics.
- Provides a list of popular and additional topics with corresponding IDs.
- Includes usage instructions and important notes, such as cookie requirements and content length limits.
